summary: Homer "Jan" Bower, 78, of Dillon, fell from his boat and drowned at Antero Reservoir; a nearby pontoon boat operator went ashore to call 911 instead of rendering aid; Hartsel Fire Department arrived within 15 minutes of the call but too late to save him; Park County Coroner investigated; water temperature below 50F.
responding_agency: Hartsel Fire Protection District (Park County Coroner's Office investigated)
